children.value: > Fact From Story Meta struggles to navigate the cultural and linguistic nuances of Arabic, a language with over 25 dialects, and has been criticized for neglecting to adequately diversify its language resources.

> > Fact From Story The report noted that Meta’s moderation system may not be as precise for Arabic content as it was for Hebrew content, because the latter is a “more standardized language,” and suggested that reviewers may lack the linguistic and cultural competence to understand less common Arabic dialects like Palestinian Arabic.
> > > Fact From Story Meta struggles to navigate the cultural and linguistic nuances of Arabic.
> > > Fact From Story Meta has been criticized for neglecting to adequately diversify its language resources.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A lack of resources will cause a struggle.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A lack of understanding of a language leads to errors in moderation.
> Fact From Story The company may not intentionally suppress specific communities, but its moderation practices often disproportionately affect Palestinian users.
> > Fact From Story Meta’s zero tolerance policy and imprecise enforcement often suppress content from or about conflict zones.
> > > Fact From Story The company also blocked journalists in Gaza from WhatsApp without explanation. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story Meta blamed technical errors for the removal of posts about Palestine during the 2021 conflict. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Blocking journalists and removing posts is a form of suppression. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge A zero tolerance policy can lead to the suppression of content.
> Commonsense Knowledge A moderation system that disproportionately affects a specific group and struggles with their language displays bias.
